lines.speaker: rupee
lines.text: Hi, Sweetie11!!! :D

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: How have you been, Rookie? ;)
Is this the group chat of your chamber of commerce?
Not bad.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: We've met at our shop a few times before, haven't we?

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: How are those supplies treating you?
Anything I can do for you?

lines.speaker: rupee
lines.text: Hmm... How should I put this?

lines.speaker: rupee
lines.text: I know you're awfully busy right now, so this is a bit awkward...

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: Oh for crying out loud, I'll tell him.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: Is that so?

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: Our intel says otherwise.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: It says you've been under attack by marauders searching for the black box.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: The Outpost is practically a war zone right now.

lines.speaker: rupee
lines.text: How awful!! Those big meanies!

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: In light of your situation, we have reached a decision.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: We will offer you our assistance.
What kind of assistance?

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: You do realize who you're speaking with, right?

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Do we have to spell it out?

lines.speaker: rupee
lines.text: MONEY ☆

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Moolah.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: Resources.

lines.speaker: rupee
lines.text: Let me give you the lowdown.

lines.speaker: rupee
lines.text: We are in possession of coordinates leading to a massive stash of treasure up on the surface.

lines.speaker: rupee
lines.text: However, as you know, Nikkes

lines.speaker: rupee
lines.text: are not allowed to fight outside without a commander :(

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: That's where you come into play.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Considering the state your Outpost is in, I'm sure you could use some additional funds.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Besides, going up to the surface is your whole thing, isn't it?

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: This is the long and short of it:

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: You and the Counters escort us to the coordinates,

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: and we split the treasure with you.
What's our take?
I see.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: We split everything 50/50.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: We trust that you'll find this offer rather generous.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: Typically, the party who introduced the deal gets a bigger share.
Can you not bump it up a bit to sweeten the deal?
Fair enough.

lines.speaker: rupee
lines.text: As much as we would like to,

lines.speaker: rupee
lines.text: that would result in a complete absence of profit for us.
All right, forget about it.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: So, is it a deal?

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: You've made a wise choice.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: I'll inform you of the coordinates and time later.
